description: What a pinned baseline for an alert rule would be if pinned from a past date range, without saving anything: the per-day average, the total, the days counted and the days with data, for a usage metric and slice (for example gcp.bigquery.bytes_billed over the two weeks after a cleanup). Pass the same range as condition.pin to create_alert_rule or update_alert_rule to pin it. Mirrors POST /api/accounts/:accountId/alert-rules/baseline-preview.

end_date.description: Last day of the range, inclusive; must be a complete day

start_date.description: First day of the range, YYYY-MM-DD

name: preview_alert_baseline
